description: Has an openbindings field whose value is a valid Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 string.
notes: Pre-release openbindings values are not exercised as positive cases here: per §8.1 a tool refuses a pre-release it does not declare support for (OBI-T-04), so a pre-release document is not globally valid even though the pre-release syntax is valid SemVer 2.0.0. SemVer's acceptance of pre-release syntax is covered at the SDK unit level. The leading-zero pre-release case below is a negative SemVer-pattern test and is unaffected. Every positive here is on the 0.2 line, the only line whose text this corpus has: a fixture asserts a verdict, and a version on another line is judged only under that line's text. Versions of other lines are OBI-T-04 scenarios with the outcome interpreted (T04-S-37, T04-S-38).

tests.description: release version whose patch number exceeds 64 bits: SemVer 2.0.0 sets no bound on a numeric identifier, and the patch number carries no meaning (section 8.1)
openbindings value is a number, not a string
minor version with a leading zero is not SemVer 2.0.0, whose X.Y.Z numbers carry no leading zeros
version followed by a newline is not a SemVer 2.0.0 string
a hyphen with no prerelease identifiers after it is not SemVer 2.0.0, whose pre-release is one or more identifiers
